title: AMD Stock News (Oct 15, 2026): AMD Falls 5.7% to $570.82
summary: AMD fell 5.73% to $570.82 on Oct 14, 2026, as a CoreWeave bond sell-off raised AI spending concerns, outpacing the Nasdaq's 1.88% drop.
body_markdown:
## Why AMD Stock Fell


Financial media tied the drop to pressure on the wider AI trade rather than to a company announcement. According to[Barron's](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/02b4e834-4dc3-3b57-9736-5c4291f5bfe7/amd-stock-takes-a-bigger-hit.html) , the CoreWeave bond sell-off revived worries about how much companies will keep spending on AI infrastructure, and AMD took a bigger hit than many peers. Investor's Business Daily grouped AMD with Dell and CoreWeave as names that dived in an AI-led sell-off on October 14.


The decline came two days after a product launch. Per[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/amd-stocks-fall-3-8-170944597.html) , AMD unveiled its Helion rack designs on October 12, including a CPU-only configuration that packs up to 32,768 sixth-generation EPYC cores into one rack and a combined design with Instinct MI350P GPU nodes. GuruFocus noted the shares were already down about 3.76% by 10:30 a.m. EST on October 14, and it did not link the slide to the launch.


## AMD Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Helion broadens how customers can buy AMD processors for AI agent workloads, and partner configurations are expected in November, according to GuruFocus.
- Trading volume ran only 6.10% above average, so the sell-off did not come on an unusual surge of shares.


### Risks


- Barron's reported that stress in CoreWeave's bonds raised doubts about AI spending, a theme that can weigh on chip demand expectations.
- AMD fell harder than the Nasdaq and than Nvidia, showing how sensitive the stock has been to swings in the AI trade.
- The close sat near the day's low, and the stock remains 13.32% below its 52-week high.
